name: tr_yaxel
caption:
IF YAXEL WAS A POKÉMON TRAINER, THIS IS HIS TEAM 🎮🏀

🦀 Crabrawler, the board man: 870 rebounds in junior college, an all-time record
🛡️ Scizor, the lockdown: 2-time AAC Defensive Player of the Year at UAB
🐺 Lycanroc, the wolverine: national champ and Big Ten Player of the Year at Michigan
🐉 Dratini, the rookie: we took him at #11
🔥 Arcanine, the heater: 37 vs the Clippers, most by a Warriors rookie since Steph
🐲 Dragonite, the ace: 21.2 points a night through 10 games

Which one would you add? 👇

facts.claim: Lendeborg: 3 seasons at Arizona Western (junior college), NJCAA all-time record 870 rebounds; 2x AAC Defensive Player of the Year at UAB (2024, 2025); 2026 NCAA national champion and Big Ten Player of the Year at Michigan (Wolverines); drafted 11th overall (#11) in 2026 by Golden State; November 1: career-high 37 points vs the Clippers, most by a Warrior rookie since Curry
